 Want to do the best work of your life? With 24 million customers in 6 countries, make your mark at Europe’s leading media and entertainment brand. A workplace where you can proudly be yourself; our people make Sky a truly exciting and inclusive place to work.
   

  

 At Sky Connect we are looking for a Senior Marketing Data Analyst that will develop data\-driven solutions for go\-to\-market challenges, while also finding opportunities for optimisation and measurement to push brand and performance marketing to the next level. You will use data modelling to help feed the Marketing strategy and predict marketing performance. You will own and evolve the data that underpins our segmentation model, and the insights which decide how and when we market to our prospects and customers through various Marketing Channels (OBTM, DM, Email, Digital). You will define and implement key data processes e.g., data collection, data cleansing and analysis, for driving useful insights. You will drive the requirements for new data capability, such as identity management. As a key player in the data team, you will be responsible for ensuring our data quality and compliance, by defining KPIs, implementing monitoring measures and driving data quality issue remediation.
   

  

**What You’ll Do**
* Run our Marketing Customer Database, ensuring data is segmented, cleansed and compliant for multiple Marketing channels.
* Combine multiple sources to assure a 360 view. Join our 1st and 3rd party data to gain practical insights: customer data, prospect data and analytics data
* Deliver optimised datasets to drive prospect acquisition and customer retention \& upsell campaigns. Ensuring adequacy, accuracy and legitimacy of data
* Feed into requirements for appropriate platforms and solutions for the housing and analysis of data and improvements across our Data technology ecosystem
* Leverage sophisticated data analysis techniques and algorithms to evolve our segmentation model, to better understand and predict prospect and customer intent and eligibility for targeting
* Be part of a Data Governance Forum, responsible for developing and owning policies to be rolled out internally and assuring alignment to data governance policies and data quality processes, through quality threshold determination, strategic data quality monitoring and longer\-term remediation strategies
* Liaise with 3rd party data providers on specific data requirements
* You will lead a small team of data and reporting analysts


**What You'll Bring**
* Passion for solving business problems with data and ground breaking technology
* Minimum of 4 years’ experience in Data modelling (Segmentation, Attribution, Churn, Predictive modelling) or similar discipline, knowledge of data mining tools such as Modeller Saas, Python
* Data warehousing experience, including ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) skills. Knowledge on extracting and combining information from different data sources.
* Strong Business Intelligence skills and the ability to bring data to life
* Big data and analytical skills including SQL for enabling large scale data transformation and analysis, across a range of technologies
* Knowledge of data analytics tools, and experience using data platforms and technology: Cloud based platforms e.g. Google Cloud Platform. Data visualisation tools e.g. Tableau (or similar, Datorama), Google Data Studio, GA Cloud based platforms
* Statistical analysis skills to feed decision making
* Critical thinking and problem\-solving, using data to solve business challenges
* Management experience


**Team Overview**
 Sky Connect is a new, exciting division of Sky. We're passionate about giving small businesses a better broadband experience and we've learnt everything we know from one of the leading providers of business broadband in the United States, Comcast. With an exciting, fast\-paced start up environment, we're looking for exceptional people, to help drive our business forward. And with the support of a truly trusting and collaborative team, you'll grow alongside our business.
   

  

**The Rewards**
 There's one thing people can't stop talking about when it comes to : the perks. Here’s a taster:
   

  

* Sky Q, for the TV you love all in one place
* A generous pension package
* Private healthcare
* Discounted mobile and broadband
* Access a wide range of exclusive Sky VIP rewards and experience


 How you’ll work
   

  

 The world has changed. And so have we. We’ve embraced hybrid working and split our time between unique office spaces and the convenience of working from home.
   

  

 You’ll find out more about what hybrid working looks like for your role later on in the recruitment process.
   

  

**Your Office Base**
**Osterley**
 Our Osterley Campus is a 10\-minute walk from Syon Lane train station. Or you can hop on one of our free shuttle buses that run to and from Osterley, Gunnersbury, Ealing Broadway and South Ealing tube stations. There are also plenty of bike
   

  

 shelters and showers.
   

  

 On campus, you’ll find 13 subsidised restaurants, cafes, and a Waitrose. You can keep in shape at our subsidised gym, catch
   

  

 the latest shows and movies at our cinema, get your car washed, and even get pampered at our beauty salon.
   

  

**Inclusion**
 At Sky we don’t just look at your CV. We’re more focused on who you are and your potential. We also know that everyone has a life outside work, so we’re happy to discuss flexible working.
   

  

 We are a Disability Confident Accredited Employer, and welcome and encourage applications from all candidates. We will look to ensure a fair and consistent experience for all and will make reasonable adjustments to support you where appropriate. Please flag any adjustments you need to your recruiter as early as you can.

title: Data Scientist
description:
We’re looking for a smart and ambitious data scientist, with real entrepreneurial flair to join our team and understand our members and all the metrics that matter. Love numbers and love being commercial? This role presents an opportunity to mold the future of the data science team, explore new ideas and new technologies.
 



  





 Muzz is the world’s largest Muslim dating and marriage app. We’ve got over 15 million members and have helped more than 700,000 couples get married. We’re on our way to become the first $1 billion Muslim tech brand – but we need your help!
 



  





**Day to day** 



* You’ll be joining a dynamic data science team whose goal is to grow the company and optimize our products as we expand into new markets around the world
* You’ll be understanding our user behaviour on the platform with a view to generating actionable insights in terms of both product and marketing
* You’ll work closely with our product, engineering, marketing and user acquisition teams
* You’ll be a proactive self\-starter, driving innovation with a product focus
* You’ll be working on our production ML models driving product personalization and recommendations
* You’ll be exploring new ideas and optimization projects, and building MVPs to prove value
* You’ll be diving into a range of data across marketing and product to solve our highest impact and complex challenges
* You’ll work alongside the data analysts and data engineer in the data team to clean, transform, and build new datasets



  





**Requirements** 



* At least 5\+ years of experience in a Data Scientist, Applied Scientist, or a deeply analytical Product\-focused role
* Strong Python and SQL knowledge
* Experience in a production environment – version control, virtual environments etc
* Strong knowledge of common statistical methods
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills and presenting to non\-technical audiences
* Commercial mindset with the ability to harness customer insights to optimise our marketing and products
* Ability to work flexibly, be organized and manage multiple projects at the same time
* Ability to work collaboratively in cross\-functional teams
* Passionate about solving complex and challenging data problems
* Experience in designing and conducting A/B experiments



  





**Nice to have** 



* Experience with recommendation systems
* Familiarity with MLOps tools/practices
* Experience in consumer\-facing mobile\-first products



  





**Why join Muzz?** 




 We’re a profitable Consumer Tech startup, backed by Y Combinator (S17\) and based in London. Join our fast growing team and work on an amazing product that’s changing the world.
 


* **A great product \-** 
 We’re the leading app in this space with over 10 million members worldwide and counting!
* **Level up quickly \-** 
 Work with talented, generous people on the kinds of challenges you’ll be proud to share.
* **A diverse team \-** 
 We have people from all walks of life all adding their unique perspective. Muslims and non\-Muslims, cat lovers and dog lovers. Everyone is welcome!
* **Meaningful equity \-** 
 We’re all working together to succeed and everyone on the team gets a slice of the pie.

 We value curiosity and building something wacky (but useful!). Every quarter we organise into random teams and together we build, code, and prototype. Prizes and dinner complete the day!

 We fly the whole team to somewhere amazing twice a year to connect and have fun.

 Mini golf, hikes, super competitive Catan nights \- we’ve done it all. Maybe you’ll be at the next social?

 All full\-time members get at least 33 days of holiday, regardless of where they live.

 As a Senior Data Scientist at Konfir, you will lead efforts to analyse and interpret large datasets, extracting meaningful insights that drive strategic decision\-making for our clients. * Conduct exploratory data analysis to identify trends, patterns, and relationships in large datasets.

* Clean, transform, and preprocess data to ensure accuracy, completeness, and consistency.

* Train, validate, and fine\-tune machine learning models using appropriate techniques and algorithms.

* Collaborate with software engineers to deploy models into production environments and monitor their performance.
* Communicate findings and insights to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders through reports, presentations, and data visualisations.
* Stay up\-to\-date with the latest advancements in data science, machine learning, and statistical modelling techniques.
* Work autonomously on projects from start to finish, and be responsible for the code you write. You build it, you run it.

 We need curious and innovative minds, who can create seamless end\-to\-end experiences for our various users. We need someone who can perform in cross\-functional teams and wear multiple hats across R\&D, Product, Software Engineering, and data engineering.
 



  





 If that sounds like you, then we'll also need you to have:
 


* Proven experience as a Data Scientist, developing and implementing machine learning models and strategies.
* Proficient in programming languages such as Python or similar tools for data analysis and manipulation.
* Strong knowledge of statistical concepts and techniques, such as hypothesis testing, regression analysis, time series analysis, and clustering.
* A deep understanding of machine learning algorithms, including supervised and unsupervised learning techniques and their applications to real\-world problems.
* Hands\-on experience with machine learning frameworks and libraries (e.g. Pytorch, TensorFlow, Keras, scikit\-learn) for model development and deployment.
* Experience using LLMs
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills to effectively collaborate with cross\-functional teams and present complex findings to non\-technical stakeholders
* Understanding of the trade off between long term initiatives and tactical changes
* Strong testing practices.
* Fluency in English, with excellent written and verbal communication
* (Desirable) Experience with AWS stack
* (Desirable) Familiarity working with transactional data like banking transactions, financial systems, and regulatory compliance.



  





**Our stack** 




  




* We are language agnostic; there are many ways to solve the same problem. We do, however, have an emphasis on Python and Node.
* Backend: Python, pandas, numpy
* Infrastructure: AWS, Terraform

 Company is London based, however the role can be remote (within the UK, and abroad for some period of time as long as you’re a UK tax resident)
 



 Unlimited Paid Time Off
 



 Fortnightly gathering in the office to spend face to face time with colleagues

title: Senior Computer-Aided Drug Design (CADD) Software Developer
description:
**About Chemify**
-----------------


Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the worlds largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.


**Job Description:**
--------------------


We seek a talented and motivated Senior Computer\-Aided Drug Design (CADD) Software Developer to build and enhance our next\-generation platform.


Youll be joining a dynamic, cross\-disciplinary team of computational scientists, chemists, medicinal chemists, software engineers, data engineers, and AI researchers dedicated to accelerating the discovery of new molecules.


We are in a fast\-paced, innovative environment, and our product roadmaps are delivered in tight iterations. To be successful in this role, youll be comfortable tackling complex scientific challenges and collaborating closely to create powerful, intuitive tools for drug design and beyond.


Our software and robotic platforms empower scientists to design, analyze, and optimize novel therapeutic candidates through advanced computational tools and make them for real in our automated robotic\-assisted synthesis platform. You will develop and integrate cutting\-edge CADD methodologies, from molecular modeling and simulation to machine learning\-based tools, into a cohesive and user\-friendly application suite. We are using an API\-first architecture, and youll need a deep understanding of scientific software development, a user\-centric mindset, and proficiency in Python, C\+\+, CUDA and relevant cheminformatics toolkits.  

  



If you are passionate about solving complex problems at the intersection of chemistry, computer science, and medicine and are energized by working with scientists to create tools that make a real\-world impact, wed love to have you join our team.


**Key Responsibilities:**
-------------------------


* Collaborate with a cross\-disciplinary team of computational chemists, chemists, medicinal chemists and AI/data scientists to translate complex scientific requirements into robust and impactful software features.
* Own the full lifecycle of feature development, from conceptualization and algorithm implementation to building intuitive user interfaces and deploying scalable backend services.
* Design, develop, and maintain software for molecular modelling, virtual screening, molecular dynamics, and predictive modeling (QSAR/ML).
* Collaborate with the Infrastructure team to ensure computational workflows are optimized for performance, scalability, and cost\-effectiveness on cloud and HPC environments.
* Champion best practices for scientific software development, including rigorous testing, validation, code documentation, and ensuring the reproducibility of computational results.
* Mentor junior colleagues and share your knowledge of CADD, cheminformatics, and software engineering with the wider team.
* Contribute to team\-wide initiatives, including code reviews, design discussions, and evaluating new computational methods and technologies.


### **What youll bring:**


* MSc or PhD, or equivalent experience, in Computational Chemistry, Cheminformatics, Physics, Biophysics, Computer Science, or a related field with a strong focus on molecular modelling, molecular understanding, or related computational approaches across chemistry and life sciences.
* 5\+ years of commercial or academic software engineering experience, preferably in a scientific or drug discovery context.


* Deep proficiency in Python and extensive experience with scientific computing and data science libraries (e.g., NumPy, SciPy, Scikit\-learn).
* Proficiency in C/C\+\+ for developing or integrating high\-performance computational chemistry algorithm

  

* Experience with parallel programming and GPU acceleration using CUDA for scientific computing applications.
* Experience building scalable and robust backend services and APIs using modern Python frameworks, particularly FastAPI.
* Hands\-on experience with core cheminformatics toolkits such as RDKit.
* Proven experience building user\-facing applications or components, with a strong interest in UI/UX for scientific software. Experience with modern web frameworks React is highly desirable.
* Knowledge of relational databases (e.g., PostgreSQL) and experience writing complex SQL queries for scientific data.
* Familiarity with cloud computing environments (AWS/GCP/Azure), especially services related to batch processing, data storage, and high\-performance computing (HPC).
* Proven ability working with containerized applications (Docker) and an understanding of CI/CD principles.


**Beneficial Skills:**
----------------------


* Practical experience with molecular modelling software and libraries (e.g. OpenMM, GROMACS, MDAnalysis, PyMOL).
* Experience applying machine learning (especially deep learning, GNNs, or generative models) to chemical or biological data.
* Knowledge of advanced CADD techniques such as Free Energy Perturbation (FEP), docking, pharmacophore modeling, or quantum mechanics (QM).
* Familiarity with DevOps practices and Infrastructure as Code tools (e.g., AWS CDK, Terraform).
* A portfolio of projects or open\-source contributions demonstrating your skills in scientific software development.

description:
**About Chemify** 




  





 Chemify is revolutionising chemistry. We are creating a future where the synthesis of previously unimaginable molecules, drugs, and materials is instantly accessible. By combining AI, robotics, and the world’s largest continually expanding database of chemical programs, we are accelerating chemical discovery to improve quality of life and extend the reach of humanity.
 



  





**Job Description:** 




  





 We are seeking a talented and motivated Senior AI/ML Data Scientist to pioneer the development and application of cutting\-edge machine learning models for computer\-aided drug design (CADD) and small molecule discovery.
 



  





 You will be joining a dynamic, cross\-disciplinary team of computational scientists, medicinal chemists, and engineers. Your primary focus will be on architecting, training, and deploying sophisticated models to predict molecular properties, generate novel models, and ultimately accelerate our drug discovery pipelines.
 



  





 To be successful in this role, you will need deep expertise in modern machine learning, particularly generative AI (Transformers, Diffusion Models), Graph Neural Networks, and predictive modeling. You will leverage your skills to tackle complex scientific challenges, working with vast and diverse chemical and biological datasets.
 



  





 If you are passionate about applying state\-of\-the\-art AI to solve fundamental challenges in chemistry and are driven to see your work make a real\-world impact on discovering new medicines, we’d love to have you join our team.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities:** 




  




* Design, develop, and optimize state\-of\-the\-art generative models (eg, Transformers, GNNs, Diffusion Models) for robotic tasks synthetic routes



  




* Architect and implement scalable MLOps pipelines for preprocessing large\-scale chemical and biological datasets, model training, and rigorous evaluation



  




* Translate cutting\-edge research in AI/ML into practical solutions that address critical challenges in our drug discovery projects, such as property prediction (ADMET/QSAR), reaction prediction, and binding affinity prediction



  




* Collaborate closely with computational chemists, medicinal chemists, and software engineers to define project goals, interpret model outputs, and integrate AI\-driven insights into our discovery platform



  




* Design and execute robust experiments to evaluate model performance, focusing on chemical validity, novelty, synthesizability, and predictive accuracy against experimental data



  




* Clearly communicate complex technical concepts, model results, and strategic recommendations to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders



  




* Stay at the forefront of AI for drug discovery, foundation models for science, and multimodal learning, continuously identifying and championing opportunities to enhance our capabilities



  





**What you’ll bring:** 




  




* MSc or PhD with 5\+ years of industry or academic experience in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Computational Chemistry/Biology, or a closely related field



  




* Demonstrated proficiency in Python and deep learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow



  




* Deep theoretical and practical knowledge of modern machine learning architectures, including Transformers, Graph Neural Networks (GNNs), and generative models (VAEs, GANs, Diffusion Models) as applied to scientific problems



  




* Proven ability to lead complex AI/ML projects from concept to deployment in a scientific or drug discovery context



  




* Extensive experience working with large\-scale molecular datasets (eg, SMILES, 3D conformations), biological data (eg, protein sequences, assay data), and other scientific data formats



  




* Experience with efficient model training and fine\-tuning techniques, such as LoRA, quantization, distillation, and model pruning



  




* Strong background or hands\-on experience applying ML to problems involving protein structures, small molecule interactions, or related biological data



  




* Familiarity with scalable computing environments, GPU acceleration, and distributed training



  




* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills for effective collaboration in a multidisciplinary team



  




* A collaborative mindset, strong communication skills, and the ability to work effectively within a cross\-disciplinary team



  




* Excellent problem\-solving skills and a proactive, can\-do attitude



  




* An eagerness to learn new scientific concepts, computational methods, and software engineering practices from experienced mentors



  




* Good understanding of version control with Git



  





**Beneficial Skills:** 




  




* Hands\-on experience with cheminformatics toolkits such as RDKit



  




* Experience with Retrieval\-Augmented Generation (RAG) systems, including vector databases (eg, Redis, FAISS, Milvus, Pinecone) for querying large chemical or biological databases



  




* Experience with Protein/DNA language models (eg, ProtBERT, ESM, Evo) or protein structure prediction models (eg, AlphaFold\-like approaches)



  




* Experience with evaluation frameworks for reaction and synthetic route design, including human\-in\-the\-loop assessment and metrics for novelty, diversity, and feasibility of synthetic pathways



  




* Strong experience with relational and non\-relational databases (SQL/NoSQL), including data modeling and efficient querying for large\-scale AI workflows



  




* A portfolio of projects or open\-source contributions (eg, a GitHub profile) that demonstrates your skills and passion for AI/ML development

Accenture Data \& AI, the people who love using data to tell a story. We’re also the world’s largest team of data scientists and experts in machine learning and AI. A great day for us : Solving big problems using the latest tech, serious brain power, and deep knowledge of just about every industry. We believe a mix of data, analytics, automation, and responsible AI can do almost anything—spark digital metamorphoses, widen the range of what humans can do, and breathe life into smart products and services. Want to join our crew of sharp analytical minds? Read on to learn more about this role and who we are looking for.

**You Are:**


A thought leader and an expert in the field of Data \& Analytics, who can connect and advise senior clients leveraging your storytelling skills and strong data driven mindset. As a Data \& AI leader, you will coach our up\-and\-coming leaders and help develop their careers, in addition to guiding our diverse multi\-disciplinary workforces, on a day\-to\-day basis on solving our client’s data challenges.


As a Data \&AI Senior Manager\-Healthcare, you will apply deep delivery acumen for data driven engagements, architecting value, and leverage operating model architecture skills to influence client agendas through business insight to usher in data driven reinvention and make data governance a part of their organization culture. You will partner with our clients to make bold decisions on priority C\-Suite issues at the intersection of business, technology, and operations within a complex data management landscape, in keeping with client industry and global economic, technology and social trends.

**What you’ll be doing:**

* Lead and support consulting engagements that tackle complex interoperability and AI challenges in healthcare and life sciences.
* Provide hands\-on architectural leadership and act as a bridge between business and technology, helping clients translate goals into solution architectures and roadmaps.
* Architect and prototype data exchange and interoperability solutions, with an emphasis on scalability in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Collaborate on the design and implementation of AI\-powered solutions, using emerging tools and platforms (e.g., LLMs, automated coding assistants, AI APIs).
* Lead small teams to develop innovative solutions for clients across functions \& industries
* Stay abreast of data\-exchange/interoperability and AI technologies, academic research \& hands\-on techniques.

  

**Basic Qualifications:**

* Minimum 5 years implementing data exchange/interoperability solutions in healthcare or life sciences \- ideally in cloud environments (e.g., Azure, AWS, GCP).
* Minimum 5 years in solution or enterprise architecture roles, with the ability to design conceptual, logical, and physical architectures.
* Minimum 1–2 years of experience designing or integrating AI/ML tools or capabilities into technical solutions—such as:
* Architecting systems that incorporate AI services or models (e.g., for clinical NLP, image analysis, or predictive analytics) Designing end\-to\-end data pipelines that support AI/ML use cases in healthcare or life sciences
* Selecting appropriate AI platforms, services, or tools (e.g., Azure AI, AWS SageMaker, Vertex AI) as part of broader solution architecture
* Collaborating with data scientists, ML engineers, or research teams to ensure AI solutions are scalable, compliant, and interoperable
* Experience with clinical data models as well as data exchange standards and frameworks (e.g., HL7 FHIR, v2, CDA, IHE, etc.)
* Client\-facing experience in consulting or solution design settings, with the ability to translate business requirements into technical architecture.


English is required for this position as this role will regularly interact with stakeholders across Canada, US and other countries across our Global footprint where English is the common language. Due to the significant high volume of interactions with these English\-speaking stakeholders, which is inherent to this position, it is not possible to reorganize the company's activities to avoid this requirement.

description:
**Who We Are**



Konrad is a next\-generation digital consultancy. We are dedicated to solving complex business problems for our global clients with creative and forward\-thinking solutions. Our employees enjoy a culture built on innovation and a commitment to creating best\-in\-class digital products in use by hundreds of millions of consumers around the world. We hire exceptionally smart, analytical, and hard\-working people who are lifelong learners.


**About The Role**  

As a Data Product Manager, you are a strategic and technically adept product leader with a proven track record of delivering impactful data platforms and analytics products. You have successfully led cross\-functional teams of engineers, analysts, and business stakeholders to launch data solutions that enable insights and decision\-making. You are primarily responsible for leading strategy and management consulting engagements as well as data and AI technology delivery engagements. Your expert understanding of data architecture, analytics, and product strategy means you are able to independently lead cross\-functional teams through all stages of the product lifecycle.



As a senior member of the team, you have previously worked with clients and projects of various sizes and complexity. You will leverage your experience and Konrad's Strategy and Design Thinking Process to solve complex business problems and help guide our clients through early brainstorming and the creation of impactful end\-to\-end customer experiences. The ideal candidate will bring to the table demonstrable experience in leading medium and large teams and mentoring junior team members, as well as demonstrable experience in cloud data platforms, data governance, agile methodologies, and cross\-functional team leadership.


**What You'll Do**


* You will be responsible for engagement processes, involving leading data and AI product planning and execution, including, but not limited to, roadmapping, requirements gathering, prioritization, stakeholder alignment, implementation, and performance measurement
* Collaborate with clients to define the short\-term and long\-term (12\-24 months) vision and measurable goals for their data solutions along with being accountable for the execution

* Be a day\-to\-day point of contact for clients, managing their expectations and implementing the resolution of project and/or program\-level issues independently
* Proactively and independently look to solve problems and identify opportunities for continuous improvement
* Lead agile ceremonies, including sprint planning, reviews, and retrospectives, to ensure continuous delivery of business value
* Play the lead role in understanding and interpreting client data and AI needs, and working with data engineering and analytics teams to deliver scalable solutions
* Be a thought leader in modern data platforms, data governance, and AI/ML\-enabling technologies
* Act as a mentor to other members of the team


**Qualifications**


* Minimum 5\+ years of product management experience, including 2\+ years with a focus on data and AI platforms, data and AI products, and analytics\-focused initiatives
* Excellent experience in leading management consulting, strategy, data, and technology teams
* A strong track record of liaising with VP and C\-level executives and cross\-functional technical and business teams
* Excellent experience acting as the product manager for cloud\-based data products and solutions
* Proven experience with modern data stacks and cloud data warehousing technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Teradata)
* Strong understanding of AI/ML platforms and Business Intelligence tools
* A solid understanding of data architecture, ETL/ELT pipelines, and governance practices
* Proven history of delivering scalable and secure data solutions that support both real\-time and batch analytics
* Experience with data privacy, compliance, and security best practices
* Familiarity with data mesh, data contracts, and modern data product thinking
* Superior organizational, written, and verbal communication skills with strong presentation ability
* Excellent relationship\-building skills with the ability to influence technical and non\-technical stakeholders and foster a data\-driven culture

title: Sr. Product Manager - AdTech (Platform & UX)
description:
Fluent is building the next generation of advertising in Commerce Media. Our vision is to build an AI first network of advertisers and publishers to achieve a common objective, elevating relevancy in E\-commerce for everyday shoppers.


We have a need for an experienced Product Manager to lead our AdTech Platform capabilities and front\-end user experience.


This will involve re\-thinking from the ground up the User Experience by Role and Jobs to be Done. This will be inclusive of an API\-first architecture to enable the deployment of autonomous AI Agents, managed by our Customer Success/Operations/Optimization teams. For example, a screen to define and launch adgroups may be required by both humans and agents.


You take an AI first approach from product productivity across strategy, discovery, requirements, mockups or prototypes. This role will require a blend of AdTech, User Research, and UX Design. The team you are paired with represents the platform capabilities and front end for several business lines, which need to be architecturally separated.


We are looking for an experienced PM who is excited about a big and challenging problem space. This role will report directly to the CPO. It is an exciting time to build the foundational capabilities that will have a wide\-reaching impact, come join us!

**What You’ll Do**

* Lead the vision, requirements and launch of the next evolution of our AdTech backend and front\-end capabilities.
* Create the detailed product roadmap for internal Publisher, Advertiser, and Marketplace views to manage the business.
* Interview and document discovery calls with stakeholders to uncover true pain points, problems to be solved and synthesize into your roadmap.
* Work with our CTO, CPO and VP of Engineering to support a step change in coding efficiency and reduction in defects by leveraging AI (Claude, Co\-pilots, Cursor, Replit etc.).
* Establish and run the product intake process to get stakeholders' input and alignment on their pain points. Leverage your PM principles to strategically analyze requests, look around corners to deliver what stakeholders need and not necessarily the feature asking for in a ticket.
* You are expected to have an AI\-first productivity approach – use AI to generate wireframes, share working prototypes using Replit, synthesize pain points before solutioning.
* Define success, utilizing quantitative and qualitative data.
* Empower the commercial teams by providing crisp communication on execution plans, releases and host training sessions.

**Requirements**

* 5\+ Years of relevant Product Management Experience, with substantial experience in front end UX Design.
* Experience in owning the product strategy and roadmap in the AdTech domain (publisher placements and advertiser campaign management).
* Experience and willingness to take an AI first approach across all aspects of productivity (PMs \& Engineering).
* Ability to execute on a roadmap engaging with internal platform \& front\-end engineers, data engineers, data scientists, operational and commercial team stakeholders.

**Nice to Haves**

* 2\+ Year(s) of relevant digital advertising or adjacent experience.
* Familiarity with performance marketing measures – CTR, CPC, CPA, ROAS, etc.
* Conceptual understanding of Agentic AI, and the platform/functionality needed to support both Human and Autonomous Agent users.

**About Us**


Fluent, Inc. (NASDAQ: FLNT) is a commerce media solutions provider connecting top\-tier brands with highly engaged consumers. Leveraging diverse ad inventory, robust first\-party data, and proprietary machine learning, Fluent unlocks additional revenue streams for partners and empowers advertisers to acquire their most valuable customers at scale. Founded in 2010, Fluent uses its deep expertise in performance marketing to drive monetization and increase engagement at key touchpoints across the customer journey. For more insights visit https://www.fluentco.com/.

**Benefits**


At Fluent, we like what we do, and we like who we do it with. Our team is a tight\-knit crew of go\-getters; we love to celebrate our successes! In addition, we offer a fully stocked kitchen, catered lunch, and our office manager keeps the calendar stocked with activity filled events. When we’re not eating, working out, or planning parties, Fluent folks can be found participating in networking events, and bonding across teams during quarterly outings to baseball games, fancy dinners, and a variety of activities. And we have all the practical benefits, too…

* Competitive compensation
* Ample career and professional growth opportunities
* New Headquarters with an open floor plan to drive collaboration
* Health, dental, and vision insurance
* Pre\-tax savings plans and transit/parking programs
* 401K with competitive employer match
* Volunteer and philanthropic activities throughout the year
* Educational and social events
* The amazing opportunity to work for a high\-flying performance marketing company!


Salary Range: $150,000 to $175,000 CAD base, \+ competitive bonus plan. The base salary range represents the low and high end of the Fluent salary range for this position. Actual salaries will vary depending on factors including but not limited to location, experience, and performance.


Candidates may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors seeking personal information. Fluent recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with an @fluentco.com domain. Any outreach by Fluent via other sources (e.g. text, other domains etc) should be ignored.

description:

Occasional travel may also be necessary to support teams and initiatives across the United States, United Kingdom, and Canada, ensuring alignment and continuity across global operations.

description:
Experience Aviva
Individually we are people, but together we are Aviva. Individually these are just words, but together they are our Values – Care, Commitment, Community, and Confidence.
At Aviva Canada, we put people first, our employees, our customers, and our communities. We’re proud of a culture built on care, inclusion, and collaboration, where your voice matters and your growth is supported. We’re not just about insurance; we’re about making a real difference by protecting what matters most.
The Opportunity
We’re building trustworthy pricing data products that our underwriters, actuaries, and data scientists rely on every day. If you’re passionate about high‑quality data and love turning complex pipelines into reliable, analytics‑ready assets, this role is for you.
You’ll lead quality efforts within the Pricing Transformation team, owning test strategies for pipelines and models while contributing to analytics engineering (modelling, transformation, and documentation). Your work ensures faster releases, fewer defects, and data our stakeholders can trust.
What you’ll do:
Quality Engineering (Data Focus):* Create and approve test strategies for ETL/ELT pipelines and analytics assets. Set up test environments and representative QA datasets; execute tests, log defects, and sign off on releases.
* “Shift‑left” quality: collaborate early with data engineers, product owners and analysts to apply functional and non‑functional testing for data quality, lineage, security, and performance.
* Automate quality gates in CI/CD (e.g., Jenkins) for dbt and Airflow jobs. Implement schema/constraint tests, reconciliation checks, anomaly detection and monitoring for freshness and completeness.


Analytics Engineering (Data Modelling \& Enablement):* Design and maintain analytics‑ready models in Snowflake using dbt (naming, documentation, versioning, test coverage), scheduled/orchestrated via Airflow.
* Build robust transformation logic in SQL/Python with performance tuning, clear lineage, and re‑usable patterns; champion coding standards and peer reviews.
* Partner with product and stakeholders to translate business requirements into data models and acceptance criteria; measure outcomes with clear data quality KPIs (freshness, coverage, defect leakage).


What you’ll bring:* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.
* A Master’s degree in Data Analytics or Engineering is an asset.
* 5\+ years of professional experience in data engineering, analytics engineering, or quality assurance within data environments.
* Minimum of 2 years focused on QA/testing for data pipelines and analytics workflows.
* Strong SQL and Python, with hands‑on experience testing and validating large‑scale transformations.
* Experience with at least some of: Snowflake, dbt, Airflow, Jenkins/Git‑based CI/CD.
* Practical knowledge of data quality frameworks (constraints, reconciliation, profiling), lineage and security considerations, and defect management using Jira.
* A collaborative mindset — comfortable working with engineers, analysts, product, and platform teams.


What makes you stand out:* Experience in insurance or financial services.
* Familiarity with insurance or pricing/actuarial data contexts.
* Experience introducing observability/monitoring for pipelines and datasets.
* Comfort facilitating risk‑based testing and go‑live readiness assessments.


What you’ll get:* Compelling rewards package including base compensation, eligibility for annual bonus, retirement savings, share plan, health benefits, personal wellness, and volunteer opportunities.
* Hybrid flexible work model.
* Outstanding career development opportunities.
* We’ll support your professional development education.
* Competitive vacation package with the option to purchase 5 extra days off per year.
* Employee\-driven programs focused on gender, LGBTQ\+, origins, diversity, and inclusion.
* Corporate wellness programs to support our employees’ physical and mental health.

title: Product Designer
description:
HYBRID


  

TORONTO, ONTARIO, CANADA .
  

FULL\-TIME . NOVEMBER 10, 2025
Description


At Future Fertility, we’re revolutionizing fertility care with AI\-powered tools that bring greater clarity, confidence, and transparency to IVF and egg freezing. Our technology is used by 300\+ leading clinics around the world, empowering patients, embryologists, and clinicians to make more informed, data\-driven decisions throughout their fertility journey.  

We are a fast\-growing, mission\-driven company where science, empathy, and design meet. We care deeply about improving reproductive care experiences globally — and we’re looking for a thoughtful, creative, and collaborative Product Designer (L1\) to join our small but mighty Product \& Design team. **About the Role**
Reporting to and receiving mentorship from the Lead, Product Design, you’ll play an integral role in designing useful, elegant, empathetic, and data\-rich digital experiences across our growing ecosystem of fertility products and tools. You’ll collaborate closely with Product Management, Engineering / Development, Customer Support, and Scientific Operations to transform complex clinical and technical workflows into intuitive and meaningful user experiences.  

This role is ideal for a curious, early\-career designer who loves the full spectrum of product design — from UX strategy / research and flow mapping all the way through to high\-fidelity Figma designs. You are also a strong visual designer who gets excited about new Figma features and cares deeply about the nuances of why one design may be better than another — and can communicate why. You are someone who falls in love with the problem, not the solution.  

You’re comfortable interviewing and collaborating with subject matter experts (e.g. embryologists, fertility doctors) and cross\-functional experts (e.g. data scientists, developers). You’re also great at taking feedback, giving feedback, iterating quickly and thoughtfully, and working in a collaborative, dynamic startup environment where design quality and product impact go hand\-in\-hand.  

What You’ll Do* **Design \& iterate:** Dream up and create thoughtful and inspired UX/UI solutions across our products, from early sketches / wireframes and low\-fi prototypes, to beautiful, high\-fidelity visual designs in Figma.
* **Deep collaboration early \& often:** Work closely with Product, Customer Support (who are themselves embryologists), and Development to develop and clarify requirements and workflows, explore design solutions, and ensure smooth handoff between Product and Design through to implementation.
* **Support user research:** Participate in user discovery / planning activities including user interviews, usability testing, and data synthesis to deeply understand clinician, embryologist, and patient workflows.
* **Refine and systematize:** Help evolve and maintain our nascent design system and visual design language across reports and user interfaces for consistency, accessibility, and visual polish across platforms and channels.
* **Prototype and communicate:** Use tools like Figma or other emergent AI\-powered prototyping tools to visualize concepts and communicate design intent and requirements clearly.
* **Stay curious:** Keep a pulse on UI trends, design tooling, AI\-powered design workflows, industry best practices, and bring fresh ideas to the table.
* **Collaborate with empathy:** Work hand\-in\-hand with clinical and technical experts to ensure solutions fit real\-world fertility workflows.

  

You Might Be a Great Fit If You* Have \~1–4 years of experience in product design, UX/UI design, or related disciplines (e.g. industrial design, graphic design, medical illustration, human\-computer interaction, human factors).
* Have strong fundamentals in interaction design, visual design, typography, and usability principles across UI modalities (e.g. web apps, Windows apps, reports).
* Are proficient with Figma for UI design and comfortable across a breadth of features (e.g. component libraries, auto\-layout, prototyping, variables, styles, etc) and comfortable or willing to learn other tools (e.g. Jira, Confluence, Slack).
* Are perpetually curious and keen to learn more about the full product design process, from hypothesis\-driven discovery and research through to dev\-ready designs, polished GTM delivery, and post\-launch support.
* Communicate ideas clearly through documentation, visuals, and storytelling in design review meetings, and asynchronously through design artifacts such as UI specifications, flows, and user stories.
* Have knowledge of agile software development lifecycle processes and methodologies (e.g. user stories, backlog management, design review, UAT, etc).
* Thrive in fast\-paced, collaborative, and ambiguous environments where product requirements, design and impact evolve quickly as we learn, iterate, and grow.
* Are passionate about reproductive health, scientific rigour, ethical and explainable AI, and meaningful technology that improves people’s lives.

  

Bonus Points* Experience working with AI/ML\-driven products or data visualization.
* Experience in a startup / high\-growth SaaS company.
* Exposure to healthtech, medtech, or similar regulated environments (e.g. Health Canada, AODA, FDA, HIPAA, GDPR).
* Familiarity with motion design or animation, vector illustration (e.g. iconography, graphics), or micro\-interactions that enhance product delight.
* Interest in UX research, synthesis, and insight communication.
* Fluency in Spanish and/or Portuguese.

title: Senior Threat Hunting Specialist
description:
We are hiring a Senior Threat Hunting Specialist who combines deep threat\-hunting expertise with practical purple\-team simulation skills to support an AI\-driven detection program. The ideal candidate understands attacker TTPs in depth, can design hypothesis\-driven hunts from telemetry, and can script concise attack simulations to generate realistic logs and telemetry in a test environment for validating detections. This role focuses on attacker thinking, preparing and conducting simulations, threat detection SIEM query design and SOC detection validation. Moreover, this role will contribute to features design for ML\-driven detection capabilities.


**As a senior Threat Hunting Specialist, your responsibilities will include:**

* Perform hypothesis\-driven threat hunting projects and translate attacker TTPs into measurable telemetry signals (IOAs/IOCs) suitable for ML feature design.
* Collaborate with ML engineers and data scientists to define, propose, and validate candidate features.
* Specify feature engineering transformations, labeling rules, sampling strategies, and evaluation metrics; support feature importance and explainability analysis.
* Create hypothesis\-driven detection reports and dashboards from telemetry sources and perform threat hunting investigations using the insights surfaced by those reports.
* Design and execute controlled red\-team style simulations (scripted PoCs) in test environments to create labeled datasets for training and validation; ensure simulations are realistic, diverse, and safely scoped.
* Track emerging threats, map them to MITRE ATT\&CK, and propose new simulation scenarios and detection features as adversaries evolve.

**Requirements (Must \- have)** :


* 5\+ years’ experience in threat hunting, SOC/IR, Blue\\Red\\Purple team experince, or related security roles with demonstrable hunting casework.
* Strong understanding of attacker techniques and the ability to decompose attack chains (MITRE ATT\&CK fluency).
* Proven ability to propose hunting hypotheses and identify relevant telemetry fields/signals.
* Experience collaborating with ML or data science teams to define feature requirements, labeling strategies, and validation criteria.
* Proficient with ClickHouse and PostgreSQL, and able to produce clear, high\-quality security analysis reports based on telemetry and hunting findings.
* Practical scripting ability for attack simulation and PoC generation (Python required; PowerShell/Bash/other scripting as applicable). *Note: production engineering and model training are handled by the team.*
* Familiarity with common hunting/detection platforms and telemetry sources (SIEM, EDR/XDR, network and cloud logs, container telemetry).
* Strong analytical reasoning, incident investigation mindset, and excellent written/verbal communication skills.

**Bonus/Preferred**

* Industry certifications: GIAC GCFA, GCTI, OSCP/OSCE.
* Hands\-on red team / adversary emulation experience beyond simple PoCs.
* Familiarity with SOAR products and concepts.
* Familiarity with ML concepts and validation metrics.
* Familiarity with Fortinet product telemetry and tooling — e.g., FortiAnalyzer and FortiSIEM for aggregated and correlation logs, FortiGate traffic/event logs, and FortiEDR endpoint telemetry. Able to map Fortinet event fields to hunting features and to explain which Fortinet logs provide the signals needed for specific TTPs.

Join our team, known for its collaborative ethos, working seamlessly with global customers, internal engineering teams and product development groups. Our team culture emphasizes continuous learning, innovation, and a strong commitment to customer satisfaction. We embrace Fortinet’s core values of openness, teamwork and innovation, fostering an environment where team members support each other, share knowledge, and leverage AI to solve complex technical challenges. Our inclusive and dynamic team thrives on collaboration and is driven by the shared goal of maintaining Fortinet’s high standards of excellence in cybersecurity solutions.


**Why Join Us:**

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds and identities to apply. We offer a supportive work environment and a competitive Total Rewards package to support you with your overall health and financial well\-being. Embark on a challenging, enjoyable, and rewarding career journey with Fortinet. Join us in bringing solutions that make a meaningful and lasting impact to our 660,000\+ customers around the globe.  



The Canada base salary range for this full\-time position is expected to be between $101,600 \- $124,200 annually. Wage ranges are based on various factors including the labour market, job type, and job level. Exact salary offers will be determined by factors such as the candidate’s subject knowledge, skill level, qualifications, and experience.


Fortinet strives to provide you and your family with a comprehensive benefits package. Benefits eligibility starts on your first day of hire and comprises of 100% company paid medical, dental, and vision coverage, including a Health Spending Account and a Personal Spending Account that gives you flexibility to spend where you need it the most. Our Employee \& Family Assistance Plan (EFAP) offers you and your family access to various services like counseling, legal advice, mental health resources etc. We also provide critical illness, disability, and life insurance, as well as a Group Registered Retirement Savings Plan (RRSP) with a company match to help you save faster for retirement. **DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Êtes\-vous un ingénieur passionné par la conception des centres de données? Recherchez\-vous un défi à relever pour tracer votre propre chemin? Si c’est le cas, nous vous demandons de nous aider à faire avancer l’histoire.
  

Les centres de données AWS constituent la base sur laquelle nos logiciels et nos services fonctionnent pour répondre aux demandes croissantes de nos clients. Ce rôle offre l’occasion de collaborer avec les équipes de prospection de clientèle, les ingénieurs concepteurs, les professionnels des opérations des centres de données, des fournisseurs et des conseillers externes, ainsi que d’autres équipes interfonctionnelles pour évaluer et sélectionner des installations de colocalisation qui répondent à nos besoins commerciaux.
  

Vous serez en mesure de démontrer votre compréhension approfondie de la conception de centres de données, de l’ingénierie et de l’exploitation de l’infrastructure commune aux centres de données, aux installations de télécommunications et à d’autres infrastructures d’environnements critiques.
  

Vous travaillerez directement avec les équipes commerciales internes et les fournisseurs de colocalisation pour identifier, documenter et résoudre toutes les lacunes opérationnelles/de conception qui pourraient avoir un impact sur la capacité ou la disponibilité d’un site.  

Vous aurez l’occasion d’influencer les normes sur les produits de centre de données, de créer et d’améliorer des processus, et d’orienter notre portefeuille de centres de données de colocalisation à l’échelle mondiale. Si vous êtes un leader solide avec une grande expérience en ingénierie de conception des infrastructures mécaniques, électriques, structurelles et de plomberie des centres de données, Amazon vous offrira un environnement de travail dynamique, amusant et passionnant, unique sous tous les aspects et une opportunité gratifiante exceptionnelle.
  

Vous serez responsable des éléments suivants :
  

Diriger les évaluations de sites selon les normes établies par AWS pour les centres de données de colocalisation, les mises à niveau d’installations existantes et les efforts généraux sur le capital.
  

Effectuer des analyses de risques et des calculs de disponibilité pour l’infrastructure du centre de données de colocalisation détenu et exploité par le fournisseur afin de déterminer l’adéquation à l’utilisation ou au service.
  

Influencer les conceptions et les exigences techniques d’AWS pour répondre à nos besoins commerciaux relatifs aux produits de colocalisation d’AWS.
  

Faire des recherches et documenter l’analyse des causes profondes des défaillances de l’infrastructure et de l’équipement.
  

Travailler avec les fournisseurs et les agences locales ayant autorité pour assurer la conformité aux exigences et aux codes aux niveaux fédéral, provincial et municipal.
  

Collaborer avec les équipes d’ingénierie, d’exploitation et de mise en service pour tester et valider correctement l’installation, le fonctionnement et les performances des systèmes électriques, mécaniques, structurels, d’extinction des incendies et de contrôle critiques.
  

Soutenir les équipes d’exploitation, les spécialistes des données et les autres partenaires commerciaux pour établir des analyses de l’utilisation, de l’efficacité et des performances des systèmes critiques.
  

Vous devrez vous rendre sur les sites des centres de données (jusqu’à 50 % du temps en déplacements nationaux et internationaux).  

  

  

  

Are you an engineer with a passion for data center design and looking for a challenge to chart your own course? If so, we are looking for you to help us make history.
  

AWS data centers are the foundation upon which our software and services operates to meet the growing demands of our customers. This role provides the opportunity to collaborate with business development, design engineers, data center operations professionals, external vendors and consultants, and other cross\-functional teams to assess and select colocation facilities that meet our business requirements.
  

You will be able to showcase your in\-depth understanding of data center design, engineering, and operations of infrastructure common to data centers, telecommunications facilities and other critical environment infrastructure.
  

You will work directly with internal business teams and with colocation vendors to identify, document, and resolve any operational/design deficiencies which could impact a site’s capability or availability.  

You will have opportunities to influence standards for data center products, build and improve processes, and to guide the direction of our colocation data center portfolio on a global scale. So, if you are a strong leader with solid data center mechanical, electrical, plumbing, and structural (MEPS) infrastructure design engineering experience, Amazon will present a fast paced, fun, and exciting work environment that is unique in every aspect and offers an exceptional rewarding opportunity for you.
  

You will be responsible for the following:
  

Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers, legacy facility upgrades, and general capital endeavors.
  

Perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit\-for\-use/fit\-for\-service.
  

Influence AWS’ design and specification requirements to meet our business needs for AWS colocation products.
  

Investigate and document root\-cause failure analysis associated with infrastructure and equipment failures.
  

Work with vendors and local agencies having jurisdiction to ensure compliance with federal, state and municipal requirements and codes.
  

Collaborate with engineering, operations, and commissioning teams to properly test and validate the installation, operation, and performance of critical electrical/mechanical/fire suppression/controls systems/structural systems.
  

Support Operations, data scientists and other business partners to determine utilization, efficiency, and performance analysis on critical systems.
  

Travel to Data Center sites as required \- International \& Domestic (up to 50%)  

  

  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Diriger les évaluations de sites selon les normes établies par AWS pour les centres de données de colocalisation et les installations de communication dans la région.
  

Examiner les conceptions d’infrastructure critique du fournisseur et effectuer des analyses de risques et des calculs de disponibilité pour l’infrastructure du centre de données de colocalisation détenu et exploité par le fournisseur afin de déterminer l’adéquation à l’utilisation ou au service en fonction des services d’infonuagique et de réseaux d’AWS.  

  

Conduct site assessments against AWS standards for collocation data centers and telecommunications facilities within the region.
  

Reviews vendor critical infrastructure designs and perform risk analysis and availability calculations for vendor owned and operated collocation data center’s infrastructure to determine fit\-for\-use/fit\-for\-service for AWS cloud compute and networking services.

Services d'infrastructure AWS (AIS)  

Les services d'infrastructure AWS sont responsables de la conception, de la planification, de la livraison et de l'exploitation de toute l'infrastructure mondiale d'AWS. En d'autres termes, nous sommes ceux qui maintiennent le cloud en fonctionnement. Vous rejoindrez une équipe diversifiée composée d'ingénieurs logiciels, matériels et réseaux, de spécialistes de la chaîne d'approvisionnement, d'experts en sécurité, de responsables des opérations et d'autres rôles essentiels. Expériences Diversifiées

Nous avons été pionniers dans l'informatique en nuage et n'avons jamais cessé d'innover — c'est pourquoi des clients allant des startups les plus prospères aux entreprises du Global 500 font confiance à notre suite robuste de produits et services pour alimenter leurs activités.

We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge\-sharing, mentorship and other career\-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better\-rounded professional.

**Position Overview**
 Autodesk customers make sense of the world through rich streams of data \- from 3D scans of buildings and fluid dynamic simulations to field notes from construction sites and product usage trends. We are looking for a Principal Data Scientist to join Autodesk’s Platform Strategy and Emerging Technologies (PSET) organization and use their experience in AI/ML and Data Science to develop the next generation of applied AI solutions that power our platform and enable smarter, scalable and cost\-efficient experiences for our customers.
   

  

 As a Principal Data Scientist on our Platform Strategy and Emerging Technologies (PSET) \- Programs \& Business Excellence (PBE) team, you will play a key role in advancing the data science and AI capabilities within the company. You will serve as a subject matter expert, guiding the development and deployment of machine learning models and data driven solutions that support strategic platform capabilities. In this role, you will partner with cross\-functional teams – including data scientists, data analysts, product managers, engineers and domain experts to deliver innovative solutions that drive business impact. This role requires a combination of strong technical expertise, leadership abilities, and business acumen to address complex challenges and influence strategic decisions. * Proven leadership and mentorship experience, with a passion for developing and inspiring high\-performing teams

 **Agentic Data Specialist** 
 , you will serve as the crucial link between our advanced AI agents and the wider enterprise technology landscape. * Data Flow and Transformation: Manage the real\-time flow of data to and from the AI agent. Implement necessary data transformations to ensure compatibility between different system formats and schemas.

* Strong understanding of authentication/authorization standards like OAuth 2\.0, OpenID Connect, and SAML.
* Excellent troubleshooting skills with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex technical issues that span multiple systems.
* Strong communication skills to collaborate effectively with both technical and non\-technical teams.
* A proactive and detail\-oriented approach to building and maintaining systems.
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic, fast\-paced environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**
* Experience integrating with the Salesforce platform, particularly using Salesforce APIs and Apex.
* Direct experience working on AI or automation projects.

description:
We are on the lookout for an ambitious and driven product manager with deep expertise in international payments systems to join a growing team.


Product managers are the CEO of the product they manage, leading teams of engineers, data scientists, growth hackers, designers (and other roles). They are responsible for every aspect of the product including user research, UX/UI design, engineering, quality, data analytics, marketing, and growth.

### **About Us:**


Thirteen\-time Webby award\-winning Freelancer.com is the world's largest freelancing and crowdsourcing marketplace by total number of users and projects posted with more than 80 million users who have posted 25 million jobs. We work with everyone from consumers to NASA in over 3,000 areas as diverse as website development, marketing, copywriting, astrophysics, aerospace engineering and manufacturing.


Freelancer owns Escrow.com, the world's largest online escrow company with over US$7 billion in transactions secured, powering the sale of jet parts to oil wells. Freelancer also owns Loadshift, a marketplace with more freight on a typical day than the distance from the earth to the moon, with over 800 million kilometres posted since inception.


This won't be your typical cog\-in\-the\-machine type of job. If you're a high achiever with talent, looking for something more than a boring job in corporate, want to work with the best and brightest and don't need to be handheld, this is the job for you.


If you join a mega\-cap technology company as the 10,000th hire you might struggle to figure out the impact you are making. If you join a startup, you might get to work on the latest fad, but likely have few mentors to learn from, work on toy problems and never change the world.


At Freelancer you'll get to work on a highly diverse, global set of internet\-scale challenges where you will make a meaningful difference with real responsibility, while rapidly building your skills. We run a meritocracy \- we actively promote from within.


You'll also change lives \- our mission is to provide one billion jobs. Not many companies actually make a difference like Freelancer does in providing opportunity and income to people all around the world.

### **Requirements**

**Payments Systems Expertise:**

* Deep understanding of international payments infrastructure including SWIFT, SEPA, ACH, wire transfers, and emerging payment rails
* Proven experience with payment gateways, PSPs (Payment Service Providers), acquiring banks, and merchant services\- how to integrate and optimise
* Strong knowledge of payment processing flows, settlement cycles, reconciliation, acceptance rates, fees, and chargebacks
* Understanding of regulatory frameworks including PSD2, PCI\-DSS compliance, AML/KYC requirements, and cross\-border payment regulations
* Experience with multi\-currency payments, foreign exchange (FX), and managing currency conversion strategies

**Product Management Experience:**

* Experience leading product discovery, creating product vision, and contributing to the overall product strategy \& roadmap in support of company\-wide goals and objectives
* Proven experience managing a high\-performing team in a financial technology or payments product (preferably web\-based)
* Experience designing simple and intuitive user interfaces for complex payment workflows \- ability to create high\-quality wireframes and mockups
* Clear and demonstrated ability to grow and market a payments product

**Technical \& Analytical Skills:**

* Solid technical background with understanding and/or hands\-on experience in payments API integration, webhooks, and financial data security
* Strong understanding of modern web architecture and how it applies to secure financial transactions
* Ability to process and analyse complex transaction data sets, payment flows, and interpret them to make business decisions (ideally using SQL)
* Experience conducting formal and informal customer interviews with finance teams, payment operations, and deriving qualitative insights

**Education:**

* Preferably have a technical degree (computer science, engineering, math, science, finance, economics, etc.) or equivalent experience

### **Bonus Points if You Have Experience With:**

* Building and scaling payment systems for marketplaces, platforms, or multi\-sided payment flows
* Payment orchestration and smart routing strategies to optimise approval rates and reduce costs
* Alternative payment methods (digital wallets, buy\-now\-pay\-later, cryptocurrency, local payment methods)
* Fraud detection and prevention systems, risk management, and dispute resolution workflows
* Working with payment processors such as Stripe, Adyen, PayPal, Checkout.com, or similar
* Cross\-border remittance products or international money transfer services
* Payment ledger systems, accounting automation, and financial reporting
* Implementing ISO 20022 messaging standards or Open Banking APIs
* Escrow services, held funds management, or split payment functionality
* Managing relationships with banks, financial institutions, and regulatory bodies
* Gathering requirements and scalably building payment products in collaboration with large enterprise customers
* Implementing A/B testing experimentation to optimise payment conversion rates

**What's In It For You:**

**Career Acceleration**

* True meritocracy: Your impact directly drives your trajectory.
* Ownership culture: Run campaigns like they're your business. We reward those who think and act like owners.
* Direct CEO access: Weekly Town Halls with unfiltered Q\&A. Your ideas reach the top without bureaucracy.

**Innovation \& Learning**

* Quarterly Hackathons: Two\-day innovation sprints where marketing teams ship real solutions and compete for prizes and implementation
* Cross\-functional exposure: Work directly with Product, Engineering, and Sales leaders, building skills beyond traditional marketing
* Global scale playground: Test campaigns across 80M users and multiple products. Few marketers get this breadth of experience

**Lifestyle \& Perks**

* Premium Sydney HQ: Grosvenor Place with harbour views, plus weekly building events and wellness programs
* Friday culture: Catered lunches featuring rotating global cuisines, team celebrations, and informal strategy sessions
* Work hard, play harder: Yes, we have beer taps and a bar with killer views. We also once built a soccer stadium with two tonnes of turf. Because why not?
* Fully stocked kitchens: Coffee, snacks, and everything you need to fuel long strategy sessions and campaign sprints

Last month alone, our platforms powered commerce across 247 countries, regions and territories. Your marketing will literally help feed families, fund education, and build futures.

* **We're a Pro\-Sports Team:** We recruit the best, reward performance, and play to win

**Our mission: Enable one billion jobs globally. This is how we keep score.**

description:

title: Digital Platform Solution Architect
description:
**Location:** Perth (Hybrid)


**Sector:** Aged Care \| Disability \| Mental Health


**Employment Type:** 6\-month fixed term – project funded


**Renumeration:** $200,000 \- 250,000 pro rata\*


**Help us build the digital backbone that connects communities.**

At Chorus, we believe every person and community deserves the chance to thrive. We provide aged care, disability, and mental health services across Western Australia—and we do it differently. Our self\-organising, local team model puts people and place at the heart of how we work — small, empowered teams delivering care, support, and connection where it matters most.


We’re breaking down the barriers between service and community—and we’re looking for someone who shares our values to help us evolve our enabling systems into a modern, cloud\-based digital platform that supports scale, simplicity, and connection.


We’re looking for a Digital Platform Solution Architect to design the technical architecture that will power this transformation — ensuring that our data, integration, application, and experience layers work seamlessly together to create great digital experiences and reliable operations.


**About the role**

You’ll lead the design and stewardship of Chorus’ digital platform architecture — shaping how our technology ecosystem connects people, processes, and possibilities.


Key responsibilities include:


* Producing a unified, future\-ready digital platform solution architecture that meets Chorus’ strategic objectives and facilitating the adoption of the architecture by the organisation by April 2026\.
* Defining and documenting Chorus architectural standards and provide technical design assurance to digital projects.
* Mobilising the technical build of the digital platform and ensuring that core technical infrastructure is in place to support the delivery of Chorus’ new Knowledge Management Solution by June 2026\.
* Guide the transition from legacy systems to a cohesive, cloud\-native platform including leading technical improvement projects and teams where appropriate.
* Modernising and securing Chorus’ infrastructure and information architecture in alignment with cyber security recommendations by May 2026 (include IAM, RBAC and separation of duties).
* Co\-development and costing of a multi\-year roadmap linking digital investments to business capability growth.
* Co\-ordinating external partners, supporting vendor relationships and overseeing procurement of new technical capabilities into Chorus’ digital ecosystem where relevant.
* Participation and leadership in Chorus’ Digital Leadership Group – a technical thought leadership and decision\-making group that brings together internal technical leaders and external partners, to guide the design and implementation of Chorus’ Digital Enabling Platform and govern Chorus digital ecosystem.

**What We're Looking For**

We’re looking for a systems thinker and architect who combines deep technical engineering expertise with curiosity, empathy, and a builder’s mindset. You understand how to design secure, scalable, and human\-centred systems that enable people and communities to thrive.


* Demonstrated expertise in solution and enterprise architecture, with hands\-on experience designing, documenting, and implementing cloud\-based environments—ideally within the Microsoft Azure ecosystem (Azure AD/Entra ID, Logic Apps, Data Factory, Power Platform, API Management).
* Strong background in integration and modular architecture, applying API\-first, event\-driven and automation\-oriented design to connect core systems and reduce manual work.
* Proven ability to design data and information architectures that ensure interoperability, security, and data integrity, including experience with data modernisation, master data management, and governance frameworks.
* Skilled in embedding security and compliance by design, implementing centralised identity and access management (IAM), permission structures, and audit controls that keep people safe without adding friction.
* Experience designing experience layers and self\-service platforms that allow customers, employees, and volunteers to access the information and tools they need independently, supported by reliable automation and intuitive interfaces.
* Understanding of how to leverage AI\-native capabilities—such as large language models, predictive analytics, and automation—to improve user experience, insight, and compliance while maintaining ethical oversight and human judgement.
* Proven track record modernising legacy environments into cloud\-native, scalable platforms using configuration\-first approaches and standard Azure services.
* Confident communicator who can translate complex technical architecture into clear, actionable strategies that influence decisions at both operational and executive levels.
* Collaborative and pragmatic engineer who values co\-design, shared learning, and building sustainable internal capability over dependency on vendors.
* Able to balance engineering excellence with relational intent—designing systems that strengthen, not replace, human connection.

**Who You’ll Be Working With**

You’ll join a small, purpose\-driven team leading Chorus’ digital transformation — a group that blends strategy, design, data, and technology to create the digital backbone that connects our people and communities. You’ll work closely with our Digital Enabling Platform Lead, who stewards the overall program and brings deep expertise in digital and data strategy, product management, and organisational design; our ICT Lead, who ensures technical rigour and alignment across systems and infrastructure; and our Data Scientist/Engineer, who is establishing our foundational data architecture and analytics capability.


You’ll also collaborate with our Experience Design Lead, who ensures every digital interaction — for customers, employees, and volunteers — is cohesive, accessible, and human\-centred. Beyond the internal team, you’ll work in partnership with our trusted strategic partners in cyber security, IT service management, application development, and experience design, integrating their expertise into the design and delivery of a modern, cloud\-based platform that helps Chorus scale with simplicity, connection, and care.


**Why Chorus?**

* We’re values\-led, not profit\-driven. You’ll work for an organisation that prioritises kindness, inclusion, and connection.
* Self\-organising teams. You’ll have autonomy and trust and be part of something that’s reshaping how care is delivered, and community connection is catalysed.
* Make real impact. Your work will help improve lives—not just optimise systems.
* Flexible work environment. Hybrid/remote options available across WA.

**Ready to Enable Communities to Thrive?**

* To apply, send your resume and a brief cover letter telling us:
* Why Chorus’ mission resonates with you;
* How you would approach to the Digital Enabling Platform program of work;
* How this work aligns to your personal mission.

* We welcome applications from individuals who are looking for a fixed term contract (on costs included in salary band above), sole traders working under their own ABN and from technical consultancies who can embed a dedicated Solution Architect within the Chorus project team for approximately six months.

We’re reviewing applications on a rolling basis—apply early to be considered.


  
We work with communities and alongside people to support them to live the life they choose, with a particular focus on seniors and people living with disability and mental illness. Ultimately, we exist so local communities can thrive.

* Pattern detection and graph algorithms: Implement pattern lookups, apply graph algorithms, and link prediction tailored to project questions.
* Statistical analysis of graph structure: Compute statistics relevant for the project scope.

*Workstream B – Frontend web application (50\-100% FTE; becomes 100% when Workstream A is not active):*

* Product definition and UX: Prioritize features to deliver a usable MVP rapidly and iterate from honest feedback.
